title: Microsoft Purview: auto-labeling ceiling for SharePoint and OneDrive rises to 500,000 files a day (GCC, GCC High, DoD)
summary: The briefing passes: the Government-cloud roadmap facts and the documented policy controls, licensing and limits are supported. It correctly distinguishes the maximum throughput from an expected daily rate and leaves administrator action for the increase unstated.

claims.claim: This change belongs to Microsoft Purview.
claims.quote: "products": ["Microsoft Purview"]

claims.claim: Auto-labeling policies run continuously until deleted.
claims.quote: Auto-labeling policies run continuously until they're deleted.

claims.claim: New and modified files are included using current policy settings.
claims.quote: For example, new and modified files will be included with the current policy settings.

claims.claim: The roadmap says the increase helps label and protect existing data sooner.
claims.quote: This helps organizations label and protect more of their data at rest, faster, closing labeling gaps across existing content.

claims.claim: The roadmap connects the increase to preparing data for Microsoft 365 Copilot.
claims.quote: With sensitivity labels and protection settings applied to more files sooner, organizations can better prepare their data estate for Microsoft 365 Copilot with greater confidence.

claims.where: Why it matters; Risk assessment: Data exposure; rationale: risk
claims.claim: Labels applied by auto-labeling policies can apply encryption to SharePoint and OneDrive files.
claims.quote: When the auto-labeling policy includes locations for SharePoint or OneDrive, the label must be configured for the Assign permissions now setting, and User access to content expires must be set to Never.

claims.claim: For an encrypting label, the Rights Management issuer and owner is the account that last modified the file.
claims.quote: When the label applies encryption, the Rights Management issuer and Rights Management owner is the account that last modified the file.

claims.claim: Users do not take part in service-side auto-labeling.
claims.quote: Because the user doesn't interact with the labeling process, auto-labeling policies don't support recommended labeling

claims.claim: Auto-labeling policies do not support recommended labeling.
claims.quote: auto-labeling policies don't support recommended labeling

claims.claim: The Purview location-control route is Solutions > Information Protection > Policies > Auto-labeling policies > policy > Edit policy > Choose locations where you want to apply the label.
claims.quote: Solutions > Information Protection > Policies > Auto-labeling policies. Select your policy to see the details ... For a policy in the Off section, select the Edit policy button ... For the page Choose locations where you want to apply the label: Select and specify locations

claims.claim: Set-AutoSensitivityLabelPolicy -Identity <policy name> -AddSharePointLocation <site URLs> adds SharePoint locations to the named policy.
claims.quote: Set-AutoSensitivityLabelPolicy -Identity "Main PII" -AddSharePointLocation "https://my.url1","https://my.url2" -AddOneDriveLocation "https://my.url3","https://my.url4"

claims.claim: The corresponding OneDrive parameter is -AddOneDriveLocation.
claims.quote: The AddOneDriveLocation parameter specifies the OneDrive sites to add to the list of included sites when you aren't using the value All for the OneDriveLocation parameter. You identify the site by its URL value.

claims.claim: Both addition parameters add included sites when the respective location is not All.
claims.quote: AddOneDriveLocation ... included sites when you aren't using the value All for the OneDriveLocation parameter. ... AddSharePointLocation ... included sites when you aren't using the value All for the SharePointLocation parameter.

claims.claim: Edit policy is documented for policies in Off.
claims.quote: For a policy in the Off section, select the Edit policy button.

claims.claim: Edit policy is documented for policies in Simulation.
claims.quote: For policy in the Simulation section, select the Edit policy option at the top of the page, from either tab.

claims.claim: Narrowing one policy's locations does not change the aggregate tenant ceiling.
claims.quote: The absolute maximum throughput is 500,000 automatically labeled SharePoint and OneDrive files per tenant per day, in aggregate across all auto-labeling policies.

claims.claim: The Purview enforcement-control route is Solutions > Information Protection > Policies > Auto-labeling policies > policy > Turn on policy.
claims.quote: Solutions > Information Protection > Policies > Auto-labeling policies. ... Select your policy to see the details of the configuration and status ... When you're ready to run the policy without simulation, select the Turn on policy option.

claims.claim: Set-AutoSensitivityLabelPolicy -Identity <policy name> -Mode Enable enables enforcement on the named policy.
claims.quote: The Identity parameter specifies the auto-labeling policy that you want to modify. ... The Mode parameter specifies the action and notification level of the auto-labeling policy. ... Enable: The policy is enabled for actions and notifications.

claims.claim: TestWithoutNotifications is the simulation/test Mode value.
claims.quote: TestWithoutNotifications: An audit mode where no actions are taken, and no notifications are sent (Test mode).

claims.claim: Neither a tenant UI setting nor an API setting for the daily auto-labeling ceiling is documented.
claims.quote: Searched: Microsoft Purview auto-labeling tenant daily throughput ceiling configure limit PowerShell Set-AutoSensitivityLabelPolicy; auto-labeling 500,000 setting PowerShell. Read auto-labeling portal guidance and the full policy cmdlet parameter names; no ceiling control found.
